title: A flat-Cauchy subsequence from total boundedness (Simon Ch. 6, 7.2, (5))
statement: Assume the following proposition. (IS) [conjunct (c) of the frozen statement of cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub] For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and IM A, B ∈ 𝒟_n(U), the current A − B is IM. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and X_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) (j ∈ ℕ). Suppose that for every η ∈ (0, ∞] there is a finite set 𝒬 ⊆ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) such that for every j there are Q ∈ 𝒬 and integer multiplicity R ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(U), S ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) with X_j − Q − S = ∂R and M(R) + M(S) ≤ η. Then there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ such that for every r ∈ ℕ there are integer multiplicity R_r ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(U), S_r ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) with X_{φ(r+1)} − X_{φ(r)} − S_r = ∂R_r and M(R_r) + M(S_r) ≤ 2^{−r} (that is, (2⁻¹)^r in [0, ∞]). Conventions: 𝒟_d(U) is the space of d-currents in U (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn U d) and 𝒟^d(U) the test d-forms in U (TestFormOn U d: smooth forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U); |α| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector (covectorEuclideanNorm); M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (such ω are called admissible for M_G), and M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X) for X ∈ 𝒟_d(U); spt is the support of Simon 6.2.11 (GeometricCurrentOn.support); IM means integer multiplicity (contract IsIntegerMultiplicity), an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) is the contract structure IMRep with R.measure = θ·Hⁿ⌞M, R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ (⟨ω, ξ⟩ := ξ(x)(ω(x))) and R represents X when X(ω) = R.action(ω) for all test forms ω; subtraction of currents is the contract instance Sub; X ⇀ Y is WeaklyConvergesOn.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ η : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < η → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ j, ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ X j - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ η) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ r, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ X (φ (r + 1)) - X (φ r) - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r
